title: AG1 — QUIET KITCHEN
lessons: The player stops on an AG1 social ad offering a first-order kit with the powder and the tools to start the routine.
The player opens a new AG1 pouch and finds a larger scoop because the formula and serving size changed.

text: The player stops on an AG1 social ad offering a first-order kit with the powder and the tools to start the routine.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: This is a lot of equipment for a green drink.

entry-first-2.speaker: AG1
text: You stopped on the ad, so I am making the first try easy.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: Easy or committed?

entry-first-4.speaker: AG1
text: Pouch, shaker, canister, scoop, travel packs. You can call it a kit. You do not have to call it a lifestyle.

choice-first.speaker: AG1
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: Every supplement ad makes the morning sound fixable.
I do not want a whole system for one drink.

first-1.speaker: AG1
text: Good. Use what helps and ignore the ceremonial feeling.

first-1-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Ceremonial is exactly what the canister was giving me.

first-1-2.speaker: AG1
text: The canister has been humbled.

first-2.speaker: AG1
text: I cannot fix your morning. I can make one part of it more organized.

first-3.speaker: AG1
text: Fair. If the kit feels like clutter before you even start, it is not helping.
The player opens a new AG1 pouch and finds a larger scoop because the formula and serving size changed.

entry-return-1.speaker: AG1
text: Before you make that, use the new scoop.

entry-return-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: There is a new scoop now?

entry-return-3.speaker: AG1
text: The serving went from twelve grams to thirteen. The old one is too small.

entry-return-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: I had finally stopped thinking about the scoop.

entry-return-5.speaker: AG1
text: I know. The formula changed, so the ritual moved with it.

choice-return.speaker: AG1
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like that you are improving it.
Why change the thing I finally got used to?
A special scoop for green powder is ridiculous.

return-1.speaker: AG1
text: Then give the new version a fair shot. I am glad the change feels worth the tiny inconvenience.

return-2.speaker: AG1
text: Fair. A routine only feels easy after it stops changing on you.

return-3.speaker: AG1
text: It is a scoop, not a lifestyle event. But yes, you do need the bigger one for this pouch.
